title: aphyllon validum subsp. howellii
intro: Aphyllon validum subsp. howellii, commonly known as Howell's Aphyllon, is a rare, leafless succulent plant native to California, USA. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and prevent infection. The therapeutic actions of Howell's Aphyllon include its ability to reduce fever, and its potential to be used as an antiseptic and a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
